d: Asaduddin Owaisi of AIMIM and Chandrashekhar Azad of Azad Samaj Party (Kanshi Ram) announced the Social Transformation Front (Samajik Parivartan Morcha) in Lucknow, declaring Chandrashekhar Azad as the Chief Minister face for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. The alliance plans to contest all 403 seats aiming to unite Muslim and Dalit voters, challenge Akhilesh Yadav’s SP-PDA equation, and potentially act as a king-breaker by splitting votes in key constituencies.
